create_vec3_structure: create a Vec3 ctypes structure with x, y, z float fields for 3D vector representation
create_triangle_structure: create a Triangle ctypes structure composed of three Vec3 points for geometric triangle representation
build_polyhedron: build a Polyhedron ctypes structure with a dynamic array of Triangle elements using the Polyhedron factory function
load_protocol_library: load the shared_protocol.so shared library and bind SerializePolyhedron, DeserializePolyhedron, and GetSerializedPolyhedron C functions via ctypes
run_serialize_deserialize: run the main function to serialize a Polyhedron to a buffer and deserialize it back using the loaded protocol library
